mercury/cougar.name: Cougar
mercury/cougar.description: The Mercury Cougar was a sporty front-wheel-drive coupe based on the Ford Contour platform, aimed at attracting younger buyers to the Mercury brand. With its distinctive new-edge design and available V6 engine, the Cougar was a bold departure from Mercury's traditional conservative image.

hummer/h2.name: H2
hummer/h2.description: The Hummer H2 became a cultural phenomenon of the early 2000s, offering imposing military-inspired styling and genuine off-road capability in a civilian package. Built on a modified Chevrolet Tahoe platform with a Vortec V8, the H2 symbolized the era of large SUVs before rising fuel prices and environmental concerns curtailed its appeal.

hummer/h3.name: H3
hummer/h3.description: The Hummer H3 was a more accessible midsize SUV that brought the Hummer brand to a wider audience with a smaller footprint and better fuel economy than the H2. Based on the Chevrolet Colorado platform, the H3 offered impressive off-road capability with its standard four-wheel drive and available Alpha V8 engine.

hummer/h1.name: H1
hummer/h1.description: The Hummer H1 was the civilian version of the military HMMWV (Humvee), offering unmatched off-road capability with its massive width, portal axles, and central tire inflation system. Famously championed by Arnold Schwarzenegger, the H1 was the most extreme production SUV available and remains a collector vehicle today.

plymouth/neon.name: Neon
plymouth/neon.description: The Plymouth Neon was an affordable compact sedan that launched with the memorable 'Hi' marketing campaign and a cheerful, rounded design. Despite its budget-friendly price, the Neon offered a responsive engine and nimble handling, earning a strong following in the SCCA racing community where it became a dominant class competitor.

plymouth/voyager.name: Voyager
plymouth/voyager.description: The Plymouth Voyager was one of the original minivans that created the segment in 1984, revolutionizing family transportation in America. As the more affordable alternative to the Dodge Caravan, the Voyager offered practical seating for seven and versatile cargo configurations that made it a family favorite throughout the 1990s.

plymouth/prowler.name: Prowler
plymouth/prowler.description: The Plymouth Prowler was a factory-built hot rod with an open-wheel retro design that made it one of the most visually striking production cars of its era. Powered by a 3.5-liter V6 and featuring an aluminum chassis, the Prowler was a bold statement that demonstrated Chrysler's willingness to take design risks.

plymouth/breeze.name: Breeze
plymouth/breeze.description: The Plymouth Breeze was a midsize sedan that shared its platform with the Dodge Stratus and Chrysler Cirrus, offering value-oriented transportation with a comfortable ride. As Plymouth's final midsize sedan, the Breeze represented the brand's emphasis on affordable, practical vehicles for everyday American families.

scion/tc.name: tC
scion/tc.description: The Scion tC was a sport coupe that became the brand's best-selling model, offering an affordable entry point to sporty driving with a panoramic moonroof as standard equipment. Built on a Toyota platform with a 2.5-liter four-cylinder engine, the tC attracted young buyers with its extensive customization options and no-haggle pricing.

scion/xb.name: xB
scion/xb.description: The Scion xB was a boxy compact hatchback that became a cult favorite, with its first generation's distinctive toaster-like shape making it an icon of the customization and tuner scene. The xB offered surprisingly spacious interior room despite its compact exterior, and its blank-canvas design made it one of the most modified cars of the 2000s.

scion/fr-s.name: FR-S
scion/fr-s.description: The Scion FR-S was a lightweight rear-wheel-drive sports coupe developed jointly with Subaru, emphasizing pure driving engagement over raw power. Powered by a naturally aspirated 2.0-liter boxer engine, the FR-S became a tuner favorite and was later rebranded as the Toyota 86 after Scion's discontinuation.

scion/xd.name: xD
scion/xd.description: The Scion xD was a subcompact hatchback based on the Toyota Yaris platform, offering a sportier look and additional features compared to its Toyota counterpart. The xD served as an affordable entry point to the Scion lineup with practical interior space and Toyota reliability.

scion/im.name: iM
scion/im.description: The Scion iM was a compact hatchback based on the Toyota Auris that served as the brand's final new model before Scion's discontinuation. Offering standard Toyota Safety Sense and a practical five-door hatchback body, the iM was seamlessly transitioned to become the Toyota Corolla iM.

suzuki/grand-vitara.name: Grand Vitara
suzuki/grand-vitara.description: The Suzuki Grand Vitara was a compact SUV that offered genuine body-on-frame off-road capability in an era when most competitors were moving to car-based platforms. With available four-wheel drive and a locking center differential, the Grand Vitara provided real trail capability at a price well below its competitors.

suzuki/sx4.name: SX4
suzuki/sx4.description: The Suzuki SX4 was a versatile compact car available as both a sedan and a sporty hatchback with available all-wheel drive. The SX4 Crossover model anticipated the subcompact crossover trend years before it became mainstream, offering raised ride height and rugged styling.

suzuki/kizashi.name: Kizashi
suzuki/kizashi.description: The Suzuki Kizashi was a midsize sport sedan that earned critical acclaim for its engaging driving dynamics and refined chassis, often compared favorably to the Volkswagen Passat. Despite strong reviews, the Kizashi suffered from Suzuki's limited dealer network and brand recognition in the US sedan market.

suzuki/xl-7.name: XL-7
suzuki/xl-7.description: The Suzuki XL-7 was the brand's largest vehicle, offering three-row seating and V6 power in a midsize SUV package. The second-generation XL-7 was developed jointly with General Motors and offered a more refined on-road experience, though it arrived as fuel prices were rising sharply.

isuzu/rodeo.name: Rodeo
isuzu/rodeo.description: The Isuzu Rodeo was a midsize SUV known for its rugged body-on-frame construction and genuine off-road capability. Powered by a 3.2-liter V6 engine with available four-wheel drive, the Rodeo competed with the Ford Explorer and Chevrolet Blazer at a competitive price point.

isuzu/trooper.name: Trooper
isuzu/trooper.description: The Isuzu Trooper was a full-size SUV that earned a reputation for rugged dependability in harsh conditions worldwide. With its Torque-On-Demand four-wheel-drive system and a powerful 3.5-liter V6, the Trooper offered serious off-road capability in a traditional body-on-frame package.

isuzu/ascender.name: Ascender
isuzu/ascender.description: The Isuzu Ascender was a midsize SUV based on the Chevrolet TrailBlazer platform, serving as Isuzu's final passenger vehicle offering in the United States. With available V8 power and a spacious interior, the Ascender aimed to maintain Isuzu's SUV presence as the brand transitioned to commercial trucks only.

isuzu/axiom.name: Axiom
isuzu/axiom.description: The Isuzu Axiom was a midsize SUV with futuristic styling that set it apart from the more conservative Rodeo. Featuring a 3.5-liter V6, available all-wheel drive, and a distinctive fastback roofline, the Axiom was praised for its bold design and comfortable on-road manners.

isuzu/vehicross.name: VehiCROSS
isuzu/vehicross.description: The Isuzu VehiCROSS was a limited-production sport utility that brought a near-concept-car design to the road with virtually no changes from the show car. With its aggressive styling, Torque-On-Demand four-wheel drive, and only about 4,153 units produced for the US market, the VehiCROSS has become a collectible cult classic.

smart/fortwo.name: Fortwo
smart/fortwo.description: The Smart Fortwo was an ultra-compact city car measuring under nine feet long, designed specifically for tight urban environments and easy parking. Created through a partnership between Swatch and Mercedes-Benz, the Fortwo offered a surprisingly safe and fun driving experience in the smallest package available on the American market.

smart/forfour.name: Forfour
smart/forfour.description: The Smart Forfour was a four-seat variant of the microcar brand's lineup, developed in partnership with Renault to offer more passenger space than the tiny Fortwo. Though more practical than its two-seat sibling, the Forfour saw limited availability in the US market before Smart exited North America in 2019.

fisker/ocean.name: Ocean
fisker/ocean.description: The Fisker Ocean was a mid-size all-electric SUV that aimed to combine sustainable materials with accessible pricing and striking design by Henrik Fisker. Featuring a solar-panel roof option and a rotating center display, the Ocean showcased innovative ideas but was cut short when Fisker filed for bankruptcy in 2024 due to production and distribution challenges.

cadillac/xt5.name: XT5
cadillac/xt5.description: The Cadillac XT5 is a midsize luxury crossover serving as one of Cadillac's most popular models. It delivers a smooth ride, spacious interior, and refined driving experience with available AWD.

cadillac/ct5.name: CT5
cadillac/ct5.description: The Cadillac CT5 is a midsize luxury sedan delivering refined comfort with available Blackwing performance. It combines American luxury with sharp handling and advanced Super Cruise hands-free driving technology.

cadillac/xt4.name: XT4
cadillac/xt4.description: The Cadillac XT4 is a compact luxury crossover offering bold styling and turbocharged performance. It provides an accessible entry to the Cadillac lineup with modern technology and a comfortable cabin.

cadillac/xt6.name: XT6
cadillac/xt6.description: The Cadillac XT6 is a three-row luxury crossover offering premium comfort and versatile seating. It fills the gap between the XT5 and Escalade with an elegant design and composed driving character.

cadillac/ct4.name: CT4
cadillac/ct4.description: The Cadillac CT4 is a compact luxury sport sedan offering sharp driving dynamics and bold American styling. It serves as Cadillac's entry-level sedan with available powerful turbocharged engines and the Blackwing performance variant.

cadillac/lyriq.name: Lyriq
cadillac/lyriq.description: The Cadillac Lyriq is an all-electric luxury SUV showcasing Cadillac's electric future. Built on GM's Ultium platform, it delivers impressive range, stunning design, and a 33-inch LED display.

lexus/es.name: ES
lexus/es.description: The Lexus ES is a midsize luxury sedan renowned for its exceptional comfort and reliability. As one of Lexus's best-selling models, it offers a serene driving experience with available hybrid powertrain efficiency.

lexus/is.name: IS
lexus/is.description: The Lexus IS is a compact luxury sport sedan competing with the BMW 3 Series and Mercedes C-Class. Known for its sharp styling, engaging rear-wheel drive dynamics, and Lexus reliability.

lexus/nx.name: NX
lexus/nx.description: The Lexus NX is a compact luxury crossover and one of the brand's best-selling models. It features bold spindle grille styling, hybrid powertrain options, and Lexus's renowned quality and reliability.

lexus/gx.name: GX
lexus/gx.description: The Lexus GX is a luxury body-on-frame SUV delivering genuine off-road capability with premium refinement. Built on a rugged truck platform, it offers three-row seating and Toyota's legendary reliability.

lexus/lx.name: LX
lexus/lx.description: The Lexus LX is the brand's flagship luxury SUV based on the Toyota Land Cruiser. It offers unmatched off-road capability combined with opulent luxury appointments and seating for up to eight.

lexus/ux.name: UX
lexus/ux.description: The Lexus UX is a subcompact luxury crossover designed for urban environments. It offers nimble handling, efficient hybrid powertrain options, and Lexus craftsmanship in a city-friendly package.

mazda/mazda3.name: Mazda3
mazda/mazda3.description: The Mazda3 is a compact car offering sedan and hatchback body styles with premium build quality. Known for its Skyactiv technology, engaging driving dynamics, and interior refinement that challenges luxury competitors.

mazda/cx-50.name: CX-50
mazda/cx-50.description: The Mazda CX-50 is a compact crossover with rugged styling designed for outdoor adventures. Built on an all-new platform, it offers Skyactiv powertrain efficiency with increased ground clearance and a wilderness-ready attitude.

mazda/cx-30.name: CX-30
mazda/cx-30.description: The Mazda CX-30 is a subcompact crossover bridging the gap between the CX-3 and CX-5. It features Mazda's premium Kodo design language, engaging Skyactiv dynamics, and an upscale interior that rivals luxury brands.

mazda/cx-90.name: CX-90
mazda/cx-90.description: The Mazda CX-90 is a three-row luxury SUV that replaced the CX-9 with even more premium appointments. It features a new rear-wheel-drive platform with inline-six and plug-in hybrid powertrain options.

mazda/mx-5-miata.name: MX-5 Miata
mazda/mx-5-miata.description: The Mazda MX-5 Miata is the world's best-selling roadster, celebrated for its pure driving joy and lightweight design. It embodies the Jinba Ittai philosophy of horse-and-rider unity with perfectly balanced handling.

mazda/cx-9.name: CX-9
mazda/cx-9.description: The Mazda CX-9 is a three-row midsize SUV delivering premium quality and engaging driving dynamics. Known for its upscale interior, turbocharged power, and refined handling unusual for its class.

volvo/xc90.name: XC90
volvo/xc90.description: The Volvo XC90 is a three-row luxury SUV that reset Volvo's design direction when it debuted. Known for its commanding presence, world-class safety features, and elegant Scandinavian interior with premium materials.

volvo/xc40.name: XC40
volvo/xc40.description: The Volvo XC40 is a compact luxury crossover and Volvo's entry-level SUV. It features distinctive Scandinavian design, advanced safety technology, and is available in both combustion and fully electric Recharge variants.

volvo/s60.name: S60
volvo/s60.description: The Volvo S60 is a compact luxury sedan offering Scandinavian design and advanced safety technology. Available in mild hybrid and plug-in hybrid variants, it competes with the BMW 3 Series and Mercedes C-Class.

volvo/s90.name: S90
volvo/s90.description: The Volvo S90 is a midsize luxury sedan showcasing Volvo's elegant Scandinavian design philosophy. It offers a serene cabin with natural materials, advanced safety systems, and refined plug-in hybrid powertrains.

volvo/v60.name: V60
volvo/v60.description: The Volvo V60 is a luxury sport wagon combining versatile cargo space with sleek design. One of the few premium wagons available, it offers the practicality of an SUV with the driving dynamics of a sedan.

volvo/c40.name: C40
volvo/c40.description: The Volvo C40 Recharge is an all-electric coupe-styled crossover combining Volvo's safety leadership with zero-emission driving. Its sleek fastback design distinguishes it from the XC40 on which it's based.

rolls-royce/phantom.name: Phantom
rolls-royce/phantom.description: The Rolls-Royce Phantom is the ultimate expression of automotive luxury and the brand's flagship sedan. Hand-built at Goodwood, each Phantom offers unparalleled refinement, bespoke customization, and a magic carpet ride.

rolls-royce/wraith.name: Wraith
rolls-royce/wraith.description: The Rolls-Royce Wraith is a luxury grand tourer coupe combining effortless performance with opulent craftsmanship. Its fastback design, starlight headliner, and V12 power create the most dynamic Rolls-Royce driving experience.

rolls-royce/dawn.name: Dawn
rolls-royce/dawn.description: The Rolls-Royce Dawn is a luxury convertible drophead coupe offering open-air grand touring at its finest. Its whisper-quiet fabric roof and hand-crafted interior create the ultimate four-seat convertible experience.

lamborghini/aventador.name: Aventador
lamborghini/aventador.description: The Lamborghini Aventador is a flagship supercar powered by a naturally aspirated V12 engine. Its dramatic scissor doors, aggressive styling, and visceral performance make it one of the most iconic modern supercars.

lamborghini/gallardo.name: Gallardo
lamborghini/gallardo.description: The Lamborghini Gallardo was the brand's most successful model ever, bringing V10 supercar performance to a broader audience. Its mid-engine layout, all-wheel drive, and stunning design made the exotic car dream more attainable.

ferrari/sf90.name: SF90
ferrari/sf90.description: The Ferrari SF90 Stradale is a plug-in hybrid supercar producing a combined 986 horsepower from its V8 and three electric motors. It represents Ferrari's technological pinnacle with all-wheel drive and pure electric driving capability.

ferrari/f8-tributo.name: F8 Tributo
ferrari/f8-tributo.description: The Ferrari F8 Tributo is a mid-engine supercar paying tribute to Ferrari's legendary V8 heritage. Its twin-turbo V8 delivers 710 horsepower with razor-sharp handling and aerodynamic innovation.

ferrari/812.description: The Ferrari 812 Superfast is a front-engine grand tourer powered by Ferrari's most powerful naturally aspirated V12. With 789 horsepower and stunning Italian design, it represents the pinnacle of the GT formula.

mclaren/720s.name: 720S
mclaren/720s.description: The McLaren 720S is a supercar that redefined mid-engine performance with its twin-turbo V8 and carbon fiber MonoCell II chassis. Its dihedral doors and prodigious power-to-weight ratio deliver breathtaking speed.

mclaren/gt.name: GT
mclaren/gt.description: The McLaren GT is a grand touring supercar designed for comfortable long-distance driving without sacrificing performance. Its unique luggage space and refined cabin make it the most practical McLaren ever built.

aston-martin/dbs.name: DBS
aston-martin/dbs.description: The Aston Martin DBS Superleggera is the brand's flagship super GT delivering 715 horsepower from its twin-turbo V12. Its name pays homage to the legendary lightweight construction technique pioneered by Touring Superleggera.

aston-martin/db11.name: DB11
aston-martin/db11.description: The Aston Martin DB11 is a grand touring coupe that reinvented the brand's GT formula with modern technology. Available with twin-turbo V8 and V12 engines, it combines breathtaking design with cutting-edge aerodynamics.

aston-martin/valkyrie.name: Valkyrie
aston-martin/valkyrie.description: The Aston Martin Valkyrie is a hypercar developed with Red Bull Racing, pushing the boundaries of road-car performance. Its Cosworth V12 and hybrid system produce over 1,100 horsepower with Formula 1-inspired aerodynamics.

bentley/flying-spur.name: Flying Spur
bentley/flying-spur.description: The Bentley Flying Spur is an ultra-luxury four-door sedan combining handcrafted British elegance with effortless performance. Its rotating display, diamond-knurled controls, and W12 or V8 power define modern grand touring.

bugatti/veyron.name: Veyron
bugatti/veyron.description: The Bugatti Veyron redefined automotive performance with its quad-turbo W16 engine producing 1,001 horsepower. As the first production car to exceed 250 mph, it established Bugatti's modern legacy of engineering extremes.

bugatti/mistral.name: Mistral
bugatti/mistral.description: The Bugatti Mistral is a limited-edition open-top hypercar marking the final chapter of the legendary W16 engine era. This roadster delivers 1,577 horsepower while showcasing Bugatti's ultimate engineering artistry.

maserati/quattroporte.name: Quattroporte
maserati/quattroporte.description: The Maserati Quattroporte is a full-size luxury sedan combining Italian passion with executive refinement. As one of the first luxury sport sedans ever created, it continues to offer a unique alternative to German flagships.

maserati/mc20.name: MC20
maserati/mc20.description: The Maserati MC20 is a mid-engine supercar marking Maserati's return to high-performance racing-inspired vehicles. Its innovative Nettuno twin-turbo V6 with pre-chamber combustion delivers 621 horsepower.

mini/clubman.name: Clubman
mini/clubman.description: The Mini Clubman is a compact wagon offering more space and sophistication than the standard Mini. Its distinctive split rear barn doors and premium interior make it a stylish alternative to conventional small wagons.

mini/cooper-se.name: Cooper SE
mini/cooper-se.description: The Mini Cooper SE is an all-electric version of the iconic Mini Cooper hatchback. It brings zero-emission driving to the Mini brand with instant electric torque and the go-kart handling Mini is famous for.

jaguar/xe.name: XE
jaguar/xe.description: The Jaguar XE is a sedan from Jaguar offering distinctive styling and performance. Decode any VIN to check for open recalls, full specifications, and vehicle history.

jaguar/xf.name: XF
jaguar/xf.description: The Jaguar XF is a sedan from Jaguar offering distinctive styling and performance. Decode any VIN to check for open recalls, full specifications, and vehicle history.

fiat/500.description: The Fiat 500 is an iconic Italian city car blending retro charm with modern practicality. Its compact dimensions and distinctive styling make it a beloved urban commuter available in electric and combustion variants.

polestar/polestar-4.name: Polestar 4
polestar/polestar-4.description: The Polestar 4 is an electric performance SUV coupe with a unique rear-window-less design replaced by cameras. It represents Polestar's push into the luxury electric crossover segment with distinctive Scandinavian design.

mitsubishi/mirage.name: Mirage
mitsubishi/mirage.description: The Mitsubishi Mirage is a subcompact hatchback offering exceptional fuel economy and one of the lowest starting prices of any new car. Its lightweight design and efficient engine make it a practical urban commuter.

mitsubishi/outlander-sport.name: Outlander Sport
mitsubishi/outlander-sport.description: The Mitsubishi Outlander Sport is a compact crossover delivering all-weather capability at a competitive price. It offers standard all-wheel drive options and Mitsubishi's comprehensive warranty coverage.

lotus/evora.name: Evora
lotus/evora.description: The Lotus Evora is a mid-engine sports car offering the rare combination of Lotus handling precision with everyday usability. Its Toyota-sourced V6 and available supercharger deliver impressive performance in a surprisingly refined package.

lotus/elise.name: Elise
lotus/elise.description: The Lotus Elise is a lightweight mid-engine roadster that epitomizes Colin Chapman's philosophy of simplicity and lightness. Its bonded aluminum chassis and minimalist approach create one of the purest driving experiences available.

lotus/exige.name: Exige
lotus/exige.description: The Lotus Exige is a track-focused coupe based on the Elise platform with added aerodynamic bodywork and supercharged power. It delivers uncompromising performance and handling for enthusiasts who prioritize driving purity.

maybach/eqs-maybach.name: EQS Maybach
maybach/eqs-maybach.description: The Mercedes-Maybach EQS is an ultra-luxury all-electric SUV representing the pinnacle of Mercedes' EV lineup. It combines Maybach's opulent craftsmanship with the EQS platform's advanced electric technology.

maserati/granturismo.name: GranTurismo
maserati/granturismo.description: The Maserati GranTurismo is a luxury grand touring coupe embodying Italian elegance and performance. Its Ferrari-derived engine note and sculptural design create one of the most emotionally engaging GT cars on the road.

jeep/cherokee.name: Cherokee
jeep/cherokee.description: The Jeep Cherokee is a midsize SUV blending everyday comfort with genuine off-road capability. Its Trailhawk trim offers serious trail performance while maintaining civilized on-road manners for daily driving.

jeep/compass.name: Compass
jeep/compass.description: The Jeep Compass is a compact SUV offering Jeep's legendary off-road heritage in a city-friendly size. It provides available 4x4 systems and Trailhawk capability at an accessible price point.

jeep/renegade.name: Renegade
jeep/renegade.description: The Jeep Renegade is a subcompact SUV bringing trail-rated capability to the smallest Jeep. Its distinctive retro-modern styling and available Trailhawk off-road package make it unique in the subcompact segment.

jeep/gladiator.name: Gladiator
jeep/gladiator.description: The Jeep Gladiator is a midsize pickup truck combining Wrangler DNA with genuine truck utility. It's the only convertible pickup truck on the market, offering open-air freedom with a five-foot bed.

jeep/wagoneer.name: Wagoneer
jeep/wagoneer.description: The Jeep Wagoneer is a full-size luxury SUV reviving a legendary nameplate. It offers premium three-row accommodations, advanced technology, and powerful V8 performance for buyers seeking American luxury.

land-rover/range-rover-sport.name: Range Rover Sport
land-rover/range-rover-sport.description: The Range Rover Sport is a performance-oriented luxury SUV combining athletic dynamics with Range Rover refinement. It offers powerful engine options including a plug-in hybrid while maintaining impressive off-road capability.

land-rover/defender.name: Defender
land-rover/defender.description: The Land Rover Defender is an iconic off-road SUV reborn with modern capability and technology. It combines legendary go-anywhere ability with premium amenities and distinctive boxy styling.

land-rover/discovery.name: Discovery
land-rover/discovery.description: The Land Rover Discovery is a versatile luxury SUV offering genuine seven-seat comfort with off-road prowess. Its ingenious stadium seating and terrain response system make it equally capable on and off the road.

land-rover/evoque.name: Range Rover Evoque
land-rover/evoque.description: The Range Rover Evoque is a compact luxury crossover with striking coupe-like styling. It brings Range Rover prestige and capability to a city-friendly package with premium materials throughout.

land-rover/velar.name: Range Rover Velar
land-rover/velar.description: The Range Rover Velar is a midsize luxury SUV known for its minimalist design and cutting-edge technology. Its flush door handles and dual-touchscreen interior create a sleek, modern aesthetic.

lincoln/aviator.name: Aviator
lincoln/aviator.description: The Lincoln Aviator is a midsize luxury SUV offering sophisticated styling and serene ride quality. Its available plug-in hybrid Grand Touring powertrain delivers both impressive power and electric capability.

lincoln/corsair.name: Corsair
lincoln/corsair.description: The Lincoln Corsair is a compact luxury crossover providing a refined alternative to European rivals. It features Lincoln's signature quiet luxury approach with available hybrid powertrain and massage seats.

lincoln/nautilus.name: Nautilus
lincoln/nautilus.description: The Lincoln Nautilus is a midsize luxury SUV that replaced the MKX with elevated design and technology. Its spacious cabin features premium materials and Lincoln's signature tranquil driving experience.

tesla/model-s.name: Model S
tesla/model-s.description: The Tesla Model S is the luxury electric sedan that launched the EV revolution. As Tesla's flagship sedan, it offers blistering acceleration in Plaid trim, industry-leading range, and continuous over-the-air improvements.

tesla/model-x.name: Model X
tesla/model-x.description: The Tesla Model X is a luxury electric SUV featuring distinctive falcon wing doors and seating for up to seven. It combines Tesla's electric performance with SUV versatility and advanced autopilot technology.

tesla/cybertruck.name: Cybertruck
tesla/cybertruck.description: The Tesla Cybertruck is a revolutionary all-electric pickup truck with a bold stainless steel exoskeleton. Its angular design and impressive specifications including armor glass windows and vault storage redefine the pickup category.

porsche/macan.name: Macan
porsche/macan.description: The Porsche Macan is a compact luxury SUV delivering genuine sports car performance in an SUV package. As Porsche's best-selling model, it combines everyday practicality with exhilarating driving dynamics.

porsche/taycan.name: Taycan
porsche/taycan.description: The Porsche Taycan is an all-electric sport sedan that proved EVs can deliver authentic Porsche driving excitement. Its innovative 800-volt architecture enables rapid charging and repeatable high-performance launches.

porsche/panamera.name: Panamera
porsche/panamera.description: The Porsche Panamera is a luxury sport sedan proving that four doors and Porsche performance can coexist brilliantly. It offers powerful engine options including plug-in hybrid variants with genuine supercar acceleration.

porsche/718.description: The Porsche 718 encompasses the Cayman coupe and Boxster roadster, delivering pure mid-engine sports car thrills. With turbocharged flat-four and flat-six engines, they offer razor-sharp handling and accessible Porsche performance.

infiniti/q60.name: Q60
infiniti/q60.description: The Infiniti Q60 is a luxury sport coupe offering bold styling and twin-turbo V6 power. Its aggressive design and available Red Sport 400 trim deliver a compelling alternative to German sport coupes.

infiniti/qx55.name: QX55
infiniti/qx55.description: The Infiniti QX55 is a coupe-styled luxury crossover reviving the spirit of the original FX. Its fastback roofline and variable compression turbo engine combine distinctive style with innovative technology.

buick/encore.name: Encore
buick/encore.description: The Buick Encore is a subcompact luxury crossover offering Buick's signature quiet ride in a city-friendly package. It provides premium amenities and refined driving experience at an accessible luxury price point.

ram/2500.description: The Ram 2500 is a heavy-duty pickup truck built for serious towing and hauling. Available with a powerful Cummins turbo diesel, it delivers exceptional capability while maintaining Ram's signature refined interior.

ram/3500.description: The Ram 3500 is the ultimate heavy-duty pickup offering class-leading towing capacity. With the available Cummins diesel producing massive torque, it's the choice for the heaviest commercial and recreational towing demands.

ram/promaster.name: ProMaster
ram/promaster.description: The Ram ProMaster is a full-size cargo van designed for commercial use and upfitting versatility. Its front-wheel-drive layout creates a low load floor while the spacious cargo area accommodates diverse business needs.

genesis/g90.name: G90
genesis/g90.description: The Genesis G90 is the brand's flagship luxury sedan showcasing Korean automotive excellence. It rivals the Mercedes S-Class and BMW 7 Series with opulent appointments, refined ride quality, and exceptional value.

genesis/gv60.name: GV60
genesis/gv60.description: The Genesis GV60 is a compact all-electric luxury crossover built on Hyundai's E-GMP platform. It combines Genesis premium design with cutting-edge EV technology including Face Connect and a crystal sphere gear selector.

bmw/5-series.name: 5 Series
bmw/5-series.description: The BMW 5 Series is a midsize luxury sport sedan that exemplifies the brand's balance of driving dynamics and executive comfort. A perennial benchmark in its class, it offers powerful engines and cutting-edge technology.

bmw/x5.name: X5
bmw/x5.description: The BMW X5 is a midsize luxury SUV that pioneered the sports activity vehicle segment. Known for its athletic handling, powerful engine options, and luxurious interior, it remains one of BMW's best-selling models.

bmw/x1.name: X1
bmw/x1.description: The BMW X1 is a compact luxury crossover combining BMW's sporty driving character with everyday versatility. As the brand's most accessible SUV, it delivers premium features and efficient turbocharged performance.

bmw/7-series.name: 7 Series
bmw/7-series.description: The BMW 7 Series is the brand's flagship luxury sedan, offering the ultimate in comfort, technology, and performance. It showcases BMW's most advanced features and sets the standard for executive sedans.

bmw/4-series.name: 4 Series
bmw/4-series.description: The BMW 4 Series is a premium coupe and convertible offering athletic performance and elegant styling. It builds on 3 Series underpinnings with a more dramatic design and sport-focused character.

mercedes-benz/e-class.name: E-Class
mercedes-benz/e-class.description: The Mercedes-Benz E-Class is a midsize luxury sedan that has defined executive motoring for decades. Known for exceptional comfort, cutting-edge safety technology, and refined powertrains.

mercedes-benz/glc.name: GLC
mercedes-benz/glc.description: The Mercedes-Benz GLC is a compact luxury SUV and one of the brand's best-selling models worldwide. It delivers a smooth ride, elegant cabin, and a range of powertrains including plug-in hybrid options.

mercedes-benz/s-class.name: S-Class
mercedes-benz/s-class.description: The Mercedes-Benz S-Class is the pinnacle of automotive luxury and technology, serving as the brand's flagship sedan. It consistently debuts the most advanced features in the industry before they trickle down to other models.

mercedes-benz/gla.name: GLA
mercedes-benz/gla.description: The Mercedes-Benz GLA is a subcompact luxury crossover blending urban agility with Mercedes-Benz sophistication. It offers turbocharged power, available 4MATIC AWD, and the brand's signature premium interior.

mercedes-benz/a-class.name: A-Class
mercedes-benz/a-class.description: The Mercedes-Benz A-Class is a compact luxury sedan serving as the brand's entry point. It features the MBUX infotainment system, turbocharged performance, and Mercedes-Benz build quality in a city-friendly size.

audi/q7.name: Q7
audi/q7.description: The Audi Q7 is a full-size luxury three-row SUV combining spacious seating with refined performance. Known for its smooth ride, advanced technology, and premium materials throughout the cabin.

audi/a6.name: A6
audi/a6.description: The Audi A6 is a midsize luxury sedan known for its elegant design, cutting-edge technology, and refined ride quality. It competes at the heart of the luxury sedan market with powerful engine options and Audi's acclaimed virtual cockpit.

audi/q3.name: Q3
audi/q3.description: The Audi Q3 is a subcompact luxury crossover offering premium amenities in a city-friendly package. It features turbocharged power, available Quattro AWD, and Audi's signature interior quality.

audi/a3.name: A3
audi/a3.description: The Audi A3 is a premium compact sedan combining sophisticated design with turbocharged performance. As Audi's entry-level luxury offering, it delivers a refined driving experience with the brand's signature Quattro all-wheel drive and advanced technology.

audi/e-tron.name: e-tron
audi/e-tron.description: The Audi e-tron is an all-electric luxury SUV marking Audi's entry into the EV market. It combines typical Audi luxury and build quality with dual-motor all-wheel drive and impressive electric range.

nissan/pathfinder.name: Pathfinder
nissan/pathfinder.description: The Nissan Pathfinder is a three-row midsize SUV designed for family adventures. It combines capable performance with modern technology and spacious seating for up to eight passengers.

nissan/sentra.name: Sentra
nissan/sentra.description: The Nissan Sentra is a compact sedan delivering an upscale experience at an affordable price. Recent generations feature bold styling, advanced safety tech, and a comfortable interior that punches above its class.

nissan/frontier.name: Frontier
nissan/frontier.description: The Nissan Frontier is a midsize pickup truck offering rugged capability with everyday practicality. Known for its reliable powertrain and competitive value in the midsize truck segment.

nissan/murano.name: Murano
nissan/murano.description: The Nissan Murano is a midsize luxury-leaning crossover with distinctive styling and a refined cabin. Known for its comfortable ride, Zero Gravity seats, and V6 power.

nissan/kicks.name: Kicks
nissan/kicks.description: The Nissan Kicks is a subcompact crossover delivering excellent fuel economy and modern technology at an accessible price point. Its bold styling and efficient powertrain make it a smart city vehicle.

nissan/versa.name: Versa
nissan/versa.description: The Nissan Versa is a subcompact sedan offering exceptional value with standard safety features and a spacious interior for its class. It provides reliable transportation at one of the lowest entry prices in the market.

acura/nsx.name: NSX
acura/nsx.description: The Acura NSX is a mid-engine sports car that revolutionized the supercar segment when it debuted in 1991, proving that a daily-drivable exotic was possible. The first generation featured a hand-built V6 with VTEC technology, while the second generation (2017-2022) added a twin-turbo V6 hybrid powertrain with three electric motors delivering 573 horsepower and Super Handling All-Wheel Drive.

gmc/hummer-ev.name: Hummer EV
gmc/hummer-ev.description: The GMC Hummer EV is a fully electric supertruck that revives the Hummer nameplate with 1,000 horsepower, 11,500 lb-ft of torque, and innovative features like CrabWalk diagonal driving and Extract Mode adjustable suspension. Available as both a pickup truck and SUV, the Hummer EV combines extreme off-road capability with zero emissions and a 350-mile range.

oldsmobile/442.description: The Oldsmobile 442 was a legendary American muscle car whose name originally stood for four-barrel carburetor, four-speed manual transmission, and dual exhaust. Born as an option package on the Cutlass, the 442 became its own model known for combining big-block V8 power with refined handling that earned it the nickname 'the gentleman's muscle car.'

plymouth/barracuda.name: Barracuda
plymouth/barracuda.description: The Plymouth Barracuda was one of the original pony cars, debuting two weeks before the Ford Mustang in 1964. The third-generation Barracuda (1970-1974), especially the Hemi 'Cuda variant with its 426 Hemi V8, is one of the most valuable and sought-after muscle cars ever produced, commanding millions at auction.

plymouth/road-runner.name: Road Runner
plymouth/road-runner.description: The Plymouth Road Runner was a no-frills muscle car that stripped away luxury features to deliver maximum performance at a budget price, licensed its name and iconic 'beep beep' horn from Warner Bros. The Road Runner with the 426 Hemi was one of the fastest production cars of the muscle car era and remains a highly collectible classic.

scion/iq.name: iQ
scion/iq.description: The Scion iQ was one of the smallest cars ever sold in America, a micro-subcompact hatchback measuring just 120 inches long — shorter than a Smart ForTwo. Despite its tiny footprint, the iQ featured a unique rear-seat design with offset seating for three passengers and earned the Guinness World Record for most airbags in a production car with eleven.

suzuki/swift.name: Swift
suzuki/swift.description: The Suzuki Swift was a subcompact car that offered nimble handling and excellent fuel economy at a budget-friendly price. The sport-tuned Swift GTi version earned a cult following among autocross enthusiasts for its lightweight chassis and rev-happy engine. The Swift was also sold as the Geo Metro and Chevrolet Metro through a partnership with General Motors.

suzuki/samurai.name: Samurai
suzuki/samurai.description: The Suzuki Samurai was a compact off-road SUV that became wildly popular in the late 1980s for its affordable price and genuine 4x4 capability. Despite a controversial Consumer Reports rollover test in 1988, the Samurai built a loyal following among off-road enthusiasts who appreciated its lightweight body, solid axles, and low-range transfer case for serious trail work.

isuzu/hombre.name: Hombre
isuzu/hombre.description: The Isuzu Hombre was a compact pickup truck based on the Chevrolet S-10 platform, representing Isuzu's attempt to compete in the American small truck segment. Available in regular and extended cab configurations with rear-wheel or four-wheel drive, the Hombre offered reliable transportation for light-duty hauling at a competitive price.

lotus/evija.name: Evija
lotus/evija.description: The Lotus Evija is a limited-production all-electric hypercar producing nearly 2,000 horsepower from four electric motors, making it one of the most powerful production cars ever built. With a target weight under 1,700 kg and advanced aerodynamics inspired by Le Mans prototypes, the Evija represents the absolute pinnacle of Lotus engineering and the future of electric performance.

mclaren/765lt.name: 765LT
mclaren/765lt.description: The McLaren 765LT is a limited-edition, track-focused supercar that represents the lightest and most powerful Longtail model in McLaren's history. With 755 horsepower from a twin-turbo V8, extensive carbon fiber bodywork, and a dry weight of just 2,709 pounds, the 765LT delivers a visceral driving experience that bridges the gap between road car and race car.

delorean/dmc-12.name: DMC-12
delorean/dmc-12.description: The DeLorean DMC-12 is an iconic sports car featuring a brushed stainless steel body and distinctive gull-wing doors, designed by Giorgetto Giugiaro and engineered by Lotus. While its rear-mounted PRV V6 engine and performance were modest, the DMC-12 achieved lasting fame as the time machine in the Back to the Future trilogy, making it one of the most recognizable cars in pop culture history.

alabama.name: Alabama
alabama.insuranceMinimumDetail: $25,000 bodily injury per person / $50,000 bodily injury per accident / $25,000 property damage
alabama.lemonLawSummary: Alabama gives a new-car buyer a lemon-law rights period of one year or 12,000 miles, whichever comes first, under Ala. Code §§ 8-20A-1(8) and 8-20A-2. The repair presumption is measured over 24 months or 24,000 miles, and at least one repair attempt has to fall inside that first year or 12,000 miles. The law treats the car as having had a reasonable number of attempts after three repairs of the same problem plus a final try by the manufacturer, or after 30 calendar days out of service, counting that final try. Before a lawsuit, send the manufacturer certified mail; once the presumption is already in place, the manufacturer gets seven calendar days to name a shop and 14 calendar days after you drop the car off to fix it.
alabama.registrationNotes: A designated agent and a licensing official may each add a $1.50 commission. Some counties add a local fee. Ala. Code § 40-12-242 sets the automobile fee.
alabama.description: Alabama requires liability insurance for all registered vehicles. The state has a lemon law that covers new vehicles purchased or leased in Alabama, and does not require emissions testing statewide.

alaska.name: Alaska
alaska.insuranceMinimumDetail: $50,000 bodily injury per person / $100,000 bodily injury per accident / $25,000 property damage
alaska.lemonLawSummary: Under AS 45.45.320, Alaska measures the presumption during the express warranty or the year after delivery to the original owner, whichever ends first, and the statute sets no mileage cap. Three repairs of the same problem, if it is still there, or 30 business days in the shop, is enough attempts. Days when the shop cannot work for reasons outside its control do not count. To demand a refund or replacement, mail written notice before 60 days have passed after the warranty or that one-year period ends; the manufacturer then has 30 days to try one last repair.
alaska.registrationNotes: Registration is biennial. There is no state sales tax. Some municipalities charge a local tax on a vehicle purchase.
alaska.description: Alaska has some of the most unique vehicle ownership requirements in the nation. While liability insurance is mandatory, the state does not require emissions testing or safety inspections for most vehicles.

arizona.name: Arizona
arizona.insuranceMinimumDetail: $25,000 bodily injury per person / $50,000 bodily injury per accident / $15,000 property damage
arizona.lemonLawSummary: Arizona measures lemon-law repairs under Ariz. Rev. Stat. §§ 44-1262 and 44-1264 during the shorter of the express warranty or two years and 24,000 miles after the car was delivered. The presumption is four repairs of the same defect that still exists, or 30 calendar days the car spends out of service. Before that presumption can be used, the manufacturer has to have received direct written notice of the defect. It also has to have had a chance to repair the car.
arizona.emissionsDetails: The Phoenix area tests every two years. The Tucson area tests annually. The OBD test fee is $16.15 in both areas. The older tailpipe test is $15.20 in Phoenix and $12.25 in Tucson. The Arizona Department of Environmental Quality publishes these fees. A vehicle operated only on electricity does not take the emissions test.
arizona.registrationFeeRange: $8 base fee plus vehicle license tax
arizona.registrationNotes: The vehicle license tax starts at 60 percent of the manufacturer base retail price. The value then drops 16.25 percent each year. The minimum tax is $10.
arizona.description: Arizona vehicle owners benefit from relatively low insurance minimums but must comply with emissions testing in the Phoenix and Tucson metro areas. The state offers incentives for electric and alternative fuel vehicles.

arkansas.name: Arkansas
arkansas.insuranceMinimumDetail: $25,000 bodily injury per person / $50,000 bodily injury per accident / $25,000 property damage
arkansas.lemonLawSummary: Arkansas runs its quality period to 24 months or 24,000 miles, whichever is later, in Ark. Code §§ 4-90-403(12), 4-90-406, and 4-90-410. After three tries at the same problem that substantially impairs the car, or one try at a problem likely to cause death or serious injury, send certified or registered mail so the manufacturer can make a final repair. A presumption also arises if that path was followed and the problem remains, if the car spent 30 calendar days in the shop, or if there were five or more attempts on separate occasions at problems that together substantially impair use and value. The manufacturer has ten days after the letter to offer a shop and ten days after you deliver the car to fix it; if it misses those deadlines, the final-attempt requirement drops and the presumption can no longer be rebutted.
arkansas.registrationFeeRange: $17 up to 3,000 lb, $25 from 3,001 to 4,500 lb, or $30 above 4,500 lb
arkansas.registrationNotes: That plate amount is the validation decal. A tag transfer is $1. An annual personal property assessment applies.
arkansas.description: Arkansas requires liability insurance and has a lemon law protecting new vehicle buyers. The state does not mandate emissions testing or a periodic safety inspection.

california.name: California
california.insuranceMinimumDetail: $30,000 bodily injury per person / $60,000 bodily injury per accident / $15,000 property damage
california.lemonLawSummary: California's Tanner presumption is Cal. Civ. Code § 1793.22. It applies during the first 18 months after delivery or the first 18,000 miles, whichever comes first. Within that time, two repairs of a defect likely to cause death or serious bodily injury, four repairs of the same defect, or more than 30 calendar days in the shop is a reasonable number of attempts. Direct notice to the manufacturer is required for the two-repair and four-repair counts only when the warranty or owner's manual clearly told the buyer to send it.
california.evIncentiveDetails: California's statewide CVRP rebate closed November 8, 2023. Income-qualified residents who scrap an older vehicle can apply for Clean Cars 4 All (cleancars4all.arb.ca.gov) before buying, and many California utilities offer EV charger rebates and EV rates.
california.emissionsDetails: California requires biennial smog checks for vehicles older than eight model years in most areas. The state sets its own emissions standards through CARB, which are stricter than federal standards. Testing typically costs $30-$70. A vehicle operated only on electricity does not take this emissions test.
california.registrationNotes: The registration fee includes a $3 alternative fuel and technology fee. That title amount is the transfer fee. A title-only application is $28. Replacement plates are $28. A separate CHP fee is $34. The vehicle license fee is 0.65 percent of value.
california.evRegistrationDetails: A model year 2020 or later zero-emission vehicle pays a $121 road improvement fee at renewal. That fee is not charged on the first registration of a new zero-emission vehicle bought from a licensed dealer.
california.description: California has the most comprehensive vehicle regulations in the country, including strict emissions standards, generous EV incentives, and strong consumer protection laws including a robust lemon law.

colorado.name: Colorado
colorado.insuranceMinimumDetail: $25,000 bodily injury per person / $50,000 bodily injury per accident / $15,000 property damage
colorado.lemonLawSummary: For vehicles sold or leased on or after August 7, 2024, Colo. Rev. Stat. § 42-10-103, as amended by SB 24-192, uses the first two years or 24,000 miles. Three repairs of the same problem, two repairs of a safety-based problem, or 24 business days out of service is the presumption, and the problem has to still be there. The manufacturer needs prior written notice by certified mail and then has ten business days after receiving it to try a cure. That cure counts as one repair.
colorado.evIncentiveDetails: Colorado offers a state EV tax credit of $750 in 2026 for new EVs with an MSRP up to $80,000, plus an additional $2,500 for EVs with an MSRP under $35,000 (Colorado Energy Office). Dealers can apply the credit at purchase. Leases must be at least two years.
colorado.emissionsDetails: Gasoline vehicles in all or parts of Adams, Arapahoe, Boulder, Broomfield, Denver, Douglas, Jefferson, Larimer, and Weld counties are tested every two years. The newest vehicles are exempt for seven model years. A vehicle operated only on electricity does not take the emissions test.
colorado.registrationFeeRange: Based on weight and specific ownership tax
colorado.registrationNotes: Specific ownership tax declines as the vehicle ages. Registration is annual.
colorado.evRegistrationDetails: The Colorado DMV lists a plug-in electric vehicle fee of $63.05. It also lists a road-usage charge of $26 for a battery-electric vehicle from July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027.
colorado.description: Colorado combines mandatory liability insurance with emissions testing in the Denver metro area. The state is a leader in EV incentives, offering substantial tax credits for electric vehicle purchases.

connecticut.name: Connecticut
connecticut.insuranceMinimumDetail: $25,000 bodily injury per person / $50,000 bodily injury per accident / $25,000 property damage
connecticut.lemonLawSummary: Connecticut's lemon law is Conn. Gen. Stat. § 42-179. The ordinary presumption runs during the first two years or 24,000 miles: four repairs of the same problem, or 30 calendar days out of service, if the problem continues. A defect likely to cause death or serious injury uses a shorter window, the express warranty or one year after delivery, and it takes two repairs. You do not have to notify the manufacturer unless the warranty or the owner's manual clearly says written notice is required.
connecticut.evIncentiveDetails: Connecticut's CHEAPR program offers $1,500 for new battery EVs (from October 15, 2026) and $500 for plug-in hybrids at participating dealers. Income-qualified Rebate+ buyers can receive up to $4,500 on a new battery EV.
connecticut.emissionsDetails: Connecticut tests registered vehicles every two years. The emissions test fee is $20. Vehicles younger than four model years are exempt. Model year 2001 and older vehicles are exempt. A vehicle operated only on electricity does not take the emissions test.
connecticut.registrationNotes: The same passenger row lists a $10 administrative fee and a $15 Clean Air Act fee. The Passport to the Parks fee on that row is $24. A vehicle four years old or newer pays a $40 emissions exemption fee. A vehicle with a certificate of origin pays a $15 greenhouse gas fee.
connecticut.description: Connecticut requires emissions testing for most vehicles and has strong consumer protection laws. The state mandates relatively high insurance minimums compared to the national average.

delaware.name: Delaware
delaware.insuranceMinimumDetail: $25,000 bodily injury per person / $50,000 bodily injury per accident / $10,000 property damage
delaware.lemonLawSummary: Del. Code tit. 6, § 5004 covers a new car for the warranty term or the first year after delivery, whichever ends first. Mileage does not cut that period short. The presumption is in place when substantially the same problem has been repaired four times and is still there, or when the car has been out of service for more than 30 calendar days. Use it against the manufacturer only after the manufacturer got a direct written notice and a chance to fix the car.
delaware.emissionsDetails: The emissions test covers New Castle, Kent, and Sussex counties. Vehicles in the first seven model years are excluded. Model year 1996 and newer gasoline vehicles use an OBD-II test. The inspection is free for Delaware residents. A vehicle operated only on electricity does not take the emissions test.
delaware.safetyInspectionDetails: Delaware inspects vehicles every two years before renewal. Vehicles in the first seven model years are excluded. The DMV conducts the inspection. Required inspections are free for Delaware residents.
delaware.registrationNotes: The document fee is 5.25 percent of the purchase price or NADA value. A duplicate plate with a sticker is $10. A plug-in hybrid under 6,000 pounds pays an additional $85 a year. A non-plug-in hybrid under 6,000 pounds pays an additional $60 a year.
delaware.evRegistrationDetails: An electric or fuel-cell vehicle under 6,000 pounds pays an additional $110 a year.
delaware.description: Delaware requires liability insurance and biennial vehicle inspections. The state has no sales tax on vehicle purchases, which can represent significant savings for car buyers.

florida.name: Florida
florida.insuranceMinimumDetail: $10,000 personal injury protection (PIP) / $10,000 property damage liability. Bodily injury liability is not required to register a private car. It is required for taxis, to reinstate under the Financial Responsibility Law (10/20/10), and after a DUI conviction (100/300/50).
florida.lemonLawSummary: Fla. Stat. §§ 681.102(9) and 681.104 give a rights period of 24 months after delivery, and the statute does not use a mileage cap. The presumption is three repairs of the same problem plus a final attempt by the manufacturer, if that attempt is undertaken, or 30 cumulative days out of service, 60 for a recreational vehicle. When the car has been out of service for 15 days, send written notice by registered or express mail so the manufacturer can inspect or repair. After three attempts on the same problem, a separate written notice gives the manufacturer one last repair.
florida.registrationNotes: The initial registration fee is $225. Florida calls that charge the new wheels on the road fee. An original used electronic title is $85.25. A lien fee of $2 may be added.
florida.description: Florida is a no-fault insurance state, meaning your own insurance covers your injuries regardless of who caused the accident. The state does not require emissions testing or safety inspections.

georgia.name: Georgia
georgia.insuranceMinimumDetail: $25,000 bodily injury per person / $50,000 bodily injury per accident / $25,000 property damage
georgia.lemonLawSummary: Georgia's lemon law, O.C.G.A. §§ 10-1-782 and 10-1-784, ends the rights period at two years or 24,000 miles, whichever comes first. One unsuccessful repair of a serious safety defect, three unsuccessful repairs of the same problem, or 30 calendar days out of service counts as a reasonable number of attempts. After that, notify the manufacturer. It then has 28 days from receiving the notice to try one last repair.
georgia.emissionsDetails: Gasoline cars and light trucks in Cherokee, Clayton, Cobb, Coweta, DeKalb, Douglas, Fayette, Forsyth, Fulton, Gwinnett, Henry, Paulding, and Rockdale counties are tested every year. For 2026 registration, that covers model years 2002 through 2023. The three newest model years and vehicles 25 model years or older are exempt. A test costs up to $25. A vehicle operated only on electricity does not take the emissions test.
georgia.registrationNotes: The title ad valorem tax is 7 percent of fair market value on a standard purchase. A new resident pays 3 percent. A replacement plate or decal is $8.
georgia.evRegistrationDetails: Georgia DOR lists an annual alternative fuel vehicle fee of $238.59 for a non-commercial vehicle from July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027. It applies to every vehicle that runs only on electricity, and to a plug-in hybrid only if it carries an alternative fuel vehicle plate. It is in addition to the $20 registration fee.
georgia.description: Georgia requires liability insurance and annual emissions testing for gasoline cars and light trucks in 13 metro Atlanta counties. The state replaced its traditional sales tax on vehicles with a one-time title ad valorem tax (TAVT).

hawaii.name: Hawaii
hawaii.insuranceMinimumDetail: $20,000 bodily injury per person / $40,000 bodily injury per accident / $10,000 property damage / $10,000 PIP
hawaii.lemonLawSummary: Hawaii's lemon law, Haw. Rev. Stat. §§ 481I-2 and 481I-3, sets the rights period as the express warranty, two years, or 24,000 miles, whichever comes first. Three exams or repairs of the same problem, one exam or repair of a problem likely to cause death or serious injury, or 30 business days out of service, is the presumption. The manufacturer has to have received a written report and a reasonable chance to repair. A dealer also notifies the manufacturer after a second report or after the car has been out more than 20 business days.
hawaii.emissionsDetails: Hawaii's periodic inspection is a safety check under HRS § 286-26. It is not an emissions test. The inspection looks at the exhaust system because a noncompliant muffler fails the safety check.
hawaii.safetyInspectionDetails: Hawaii requires a periodic safety inspection under HRS § 286-26. Most passenger vehicles are inspected every 12 months. A new vehicle does not need that annual inspection until two years after its first inspection. Since July 1, 2025, the fee is $25.75 for automobiles and trucks.
hawaii.registrationFeeRange: $46 a year plus county weight tax
hawaii.registrationNotes: Honolulu charges $10 to transfer a title within 30 days. Hawaii County charges $5. Alternative-fuel vehicles pay an extra $50. An electric vehicle is excluded from that alternative-fuel surcharge. HRS § 249-31 sets the state registration fee.
hawaii.evRegistrationDetails: Since July 1, 2025, Hawaii electric vehicles pay a state road usage charge at registration renewal instead of the alternative-fuel surcharge. Owners can choose 0.8 cents a mile, capped at $50 a year, or a flat $50 through June 30, 2028. After that, the per-mile charge is required.
hawaii.description: Hawaii requires all registered vehicles to pass a periodic safety inspection. The state has mandatory no-fault insurance and offers growing incentives for electric vehicles as part of its clean energy goals.

idaho.name: Idaho
idaho.insuranceMinimumDetail: $25,000 bodily injury per person / $50,000 bodily injury per accident / $15,000 property damage
idaho.lemonLawSummary: Idaho Code § 48-903 looks at the express warranty, two years, or 24,000 miles, whichever date comes first. If the problem was first reported during the warranty, repair attempts within three years of delivery can still support a refund or replacement. Four repairs of the same problem, 30 business days out of service, or one repair of a complete brake or steering failure likely to cause death or serious injury, is the presumption, and the manufacturer still gets one chance to repair that brake or steering failure. The four-repair and 30-day paths apply against the manufacturer only after written notice and a chance to cure.
idaho.emissionsDetails: Idaho repealed its vehicle inspection and maintenance (emissions testing) requirement effective July 1, 2023, ending testing in the Treasure Valley.
idaho.registrationFeeRange: $69 at 1 or 2 years, $57 at 3 to 6 years, or $45 at 7 or more years
idaho.registrationNotes: The $14 title fee is the state base. Counties add a title administrative fee (from $0 to $18.75) and a registration administrative fee. An electric vehicle pays an additional $140 a year and a plug-in hybrid $75.
idaho.evRegistrationDetails: An electric vehicle pays an additional $140 a year under Idaho Code § 49-457.
idaho.description: Idaho requires 25/50/15 liability coverage and verifies insurance electronically. The state repealed its Treasure Valley emissions testing requirement effective July 1, 2023. Vehicles are titled and registered through county DMV offices, with state registration fees based on vehicle age.

illinois.name: Illinois
illinois.insuranceMinimumDetail: $25,000 bodily injury per person / $50,000 bodily injury per accident / $20,000 property damage
illinois.lemonLawSummary: Illinois sets its own lemon-law period in 815 ILCS 380/2 and 380/3: one year or 12,000 miles after delivery, whichever comes first. Four repairs of the same problem that still exists, or 30 business days out of service, is the presumption inside that period. The manufacturer must have received direct written notice from the buyer, or from someone acting for the buyer. It also needs a chance to correct the defect before the presumption applies.
illinois.evIncentiveDetails: The Illinois EPA EV rebate cycle runs August 1 to December 31, 2026: $2,000, or $4,000 for low-income applicants, and $1,500 for an electric motorcycle. The vehicle must be all-electric, sell for $80,000 or less, and be bought from an Illinois-licensed dealer, and applications must be postmarked within 180 days of purchase.
illinois.emissionsDetails: Emissions testing is required for most gasoline vehicles registered in Cook, DuPage, and Lake counties, and in designated parts of Kane, Kendall, McHenry, Will, Madison, Monroe, and St. Clair counties, under the Vehicle Emissions Inspection Law of 2005. Most 1996 and newer gasoline passenger vehicles are tested after they are four years old, on the biennial schedule that matches the license-plate year. A vehicle operated only on electricity does not take this emissions test.
illinois.registrationNotes: Registration is annual and expires at the end of a month. An electric vehicle pays $251 a year ($151 plus a $100 fee in lieu of motor fuel tax). New residents have 30 days to title and register.
illinois.evRegistrationDetails: An electric vehicle pays an additional $100 a year. Annual renewal of that plate is listed at $251.
illinois.description: Illinois requires 25/50/20 liability coverage plus uninsured motorist coverage, and requires emissions testing in the Chicago and Metro East St. Louis areas. Its lemon law covers the first year or 12,000 miles, and the Illinois EPA offers a rebate for buying an electric vehicle.

indiana.name: Indiana
indiana.insuranceMinimumDetail: $25,000 bodily injury per person / $50,000 bodily injury per accident / $25,000 property damage
indiana.lemonLawSummary: Indiana calls the coverage a term of protection under Ind. Code §§ 24-5-13-7, 24-5-13-8, and 24-5-13-15. It ends at the earlier of 18 months or 18,000 miles, and the buyer has to report the problem before that term runs out. Four repairs that leave the problem in place, or 30 business days out of service with the problem still there, counts as a reasonable number of attempts. If the manufacturer made the disclosure in § 24-5-13-9, the buyer notifies the manufacturer of the claim first.
indiana.emissionsDetails: Vehicles registered in Lake and Porter counties need a Clean Air Car Check emissions test and tampering inspection every two years if they were built after 1975 and have a GVWR of 9,000 pounds or less. The four newest model years and antique vehicles are exempt. Vehicles are tested in years matching their model year (odd or even).
indiana.registrationNotes: Registration is $21.35 a year plus an excise tax based on the vehicle's MSRP class and age, and some counties and cities add an excise or wheel tax. Title is $15, and a $30 late penalty applies after 45 days (60 days for new residents). A transfer or replacement plate is $9.50, and personalized plates are $45. Supplemental fees are $242 for EVs and $81 for hybrids.
indiana.evRegistrationDetails: The BMV fee chart (revised 1/1/2026) lists a $242 electric-vehicle supplemental fee and an $81 hybrid supplemental fee under Ind. Code § 9-18.1-5-12. The fees are adjusted annually.
indiana.description: Indiana requires 25/50/25 liability insurance, and its lemon law covers cars and light trucks for 18 months or 18,000 miles. Vehicles registered in Lake and Porter counties need emissions tests every two years, and out-of-state vehicles get a VIN inspection when they are first titled in Indiana.

iowa.name: Iowa
iowa.insuranceMinimumDetail: $20,000 bodily injury per person / $40,000 bodily injury per accident / $15,000 property damage
iowa.lemonLawSummary: Iowa's lemon law, Iowa Code §§ 322G.2 and 322G.4, uses the written warranty, two years, or 24,000 miles, whichever expires first, and it counts calendar days. The presumption is three exams or repairs of the same problem plus a final attempt if one is undertaken, one exam or repair of a problem likely to cause death or serious injury plus that final attempt, or 30 days out of service. You can send written notice after 20 cumulative days out of service, after three attempts, or after one attempt on a dangerous defect. The manufacturer then has a final chance to conform the car, including 10 cumulative out-of-service days after the 20-day notice.
iowa.registrationFeeRange: 1% of value plus 40 cents per 100 pounds
iowa.registrationNotes: The annual fee is 1% of value plus 40 cents per 100 pounds. The value portion drops to 75% after seven model years and 50% after nine, with a $50 minimum, and the fee is a flat $50 at 12 model years or older. A one-time fee for new registration of $10 plus 5% of the purchase price applies when the vehicle is first registered to you. New residents have 30 days to title and register. Late renewals add 5% a month.
iowa.evRegistrationDetails: Iowa Code § 321.116 adds $130 a year for a battery-electric vehicle and $65 for a plug-in hybrid. Iowa DOT lists $9 for an electric or plug-in hybrid motorcycle.
iowa.description: Iowa requires 20/40/15 liability insurance plus uninsured and underinsured motorist coverage unless you reject it in writing. Its lemon law covers new vehicles for the warranty term, two years or 24,000 miles. Annual registration is based on value and weight, and the fee drops as the vehicle ages.

kansas.name: Kansas
kansas.insuranceMinimumDetail: $25,000 bodily injury per person / $50,000 bodily injury per accident / $25,000 property damage / personal injury protection (PIP) required, including $4,500 medical / uninsured and underinsured motorist coverage required at no less than 25/50
kansas.lemonLawSummary: Kansas applies Kan. Stat. Ann. § 50-645 during the express warranty or the first year after delivery, whichever ends sooner, and the statute sets no mileage limit. Four repairs of the same problem, 30 calendar days out of service, or ten attempts on any problems that substantially impair use and value, is the presumption. Those counts matter once the manufacturer has actual notice of the trouble. Get that notice to the manufacturer while the warranty or the one-year period is still open.
kansas.emissionsDetails: The Kansas Highway Patrol says the state does not require emissions testing, and Johnson County tells vehicle owners the same thing.
kansas.safetyInspectionDetails: The Kansas Department of Revenue says Kansas does not have a safety or emissions inspection requirement or program. A $20 VIN inspection by the Highway Patrol, or a designee, is required before titling a vehicle that comes in on an out-of-state title. Rebuilt salvage vehicles have a separate $25 inspection.
kansas.registrationFeeRange: $30 at 4,500 lb or less, or $40 above that weight
kansas.registrationNotes: Personal property tax is also assessed on vehicles. Kansas statute 8-143 lists $70 for an electric hybrid, $100 for a plug-in electric hybrid and $165 for an all-electric vehicle. New residents must title and register within 90 days, and buyers should apply within 60 days of purchase to avoid a penalty.
kansas.evRegistrationDetails: An all-electric passenger vehicle is registered at $165 under Kansas statute 8-143.
kansas.description: Kansas requires liability insurance with personal injury protection and uninsured motorist coverage, and has a lemon law for new vehicles. The Department of Revenue says the state has no safety or emissions inspection program. A VIN inspection applies when a vehicle is titled from another state.

kentucky.name: Kentucky
kentucky.insuranceMinimumDetail: $25,000 bodily injury per person / $50,000 bodily injury per accident / $25,000 property damage, or a $60,000 single limit / $10,000 basic personal injury protection (PIP) / uninsured motorist coverage at the minimum bodily injury limits unless rejected in writing
kentucky.lemonLawSummary: Kentucky's window under Ky. Rev. Stat. § 367.842 is the first 12 months or 12,000 miles, whichever arrives first. The presumption looks at that same defect: four repair attempts, or 30 calendar days the car is out of service because of it. When a reasonable number of attempts still leaves the car unrepaired, the buyer puts the problem in writing to the manufacturer.
kentucky.emissionsDetails: Jefferson County's vehicle emissions testing program, run by the Louisville air pollution control district, ended by November 1, 2003, under KRS 77.320.
kentucky.safetyInspectionDetails: Vehicles brought into Kentucky from another state need a sheriff's inspection before titling. Fees are set by county; Logan County lists $5.
kentucky.registrationNotes: The state registration fee under KRS 186.050 is $11.50; Logan County's clerk lists $21 for a yearly renewal. A 6 percent usage tax applies when ownership transfers or a vehicle is first registered in Kentucky. New residents must apply within 15 days under KRS 186.020.
kentucky.evRegistrationDetails: Vehicles with plug-in charging capability pay an electric vehicle ownership fee under KRS 138.475 on top of registration. The base is $120, adjusted annually; the AFDC lists $126 for 2025.
kentucky.description: Kentucky requires liability insurance with basic personal injury protection under its no-fault law, and has a lemon law for new vehicles. A 6% motor vehicle usage tax is collected when a vehicle is transferred or first registered in the state.

louisiana.name: Louisiana
louisiana.insuranceMinimumDetail: $15,000 bodily injury per person / $30,000 bodily injury per accident / $25,000 property damage
louisiana.lemonLawSummary: La. Rev. Stat. § 51:1943 gives the manufacturer the warranty period or one year after delivery, and the presumption uses the date that arrives first. The section does not cut the period off by mileage. Four repairs of the same problem, or 45 calendar days out of service, is the presumption, and § 51:1944 uses those same numbers for the refund or replacement. If the manufacturer misses the response or repair time in § 51:1943(A), it loses the right to a final attempt.
louisiana.emissionsDetails: LDEQ emissions testing applies to gasoline vehicles of 10,000 lbs GVWR or less registered in Ascension, East Baton Rouge, Iberville, Livingston, and West Baton Rouge parishes: anti-tampering and gas-cap checks, plus OBD II for 1996 and newer. The inspection fee in these parishes is $18 for the combined safety and emissions inspection. Act 701 of 2026 takes effect in these parishes only if EPA approves the state plan amendments.
louisiana.safetyInspectionDetails: Act 701 of 2026 prohibits inspection-certificate citations from June 30, 2026 to January 1, 2027. For personal non-commercial vehicles the inspection requirement ends January 1, 2027, except in the five Baton Rouge-area I/M parishes, where it takes effect only when EPA approves the State Implementation Plan amendments. Commercial and student transportation vehicles remain subject to inspection.
louisiana.registrationFeeRange: 0.1% of vehicle value per year, sold in 2-year increments ($20 minimum)
louisiana.registrationNotes: Automobile plates are sold for two years at 0.1 percent of value per year, with a minimum value of $10,000 ($20 minimum). Title $68.50, handling fee $8, lien recording $15 (UCC-1) or $10, and a local fee of up to $6. Electric vehicles pay a $110 and hybrids a $60 yearly road usage fee under R.S. 32:461.
louisiana.evRegistrationDetails: R.S. 32:461 road usage fee: $110 per year for electric vehicles and $60 per year for hybrids (prorated by month). OMV mails notices April 1 and May 1 for the prior calendar year; payment is due June 30.
louisiana.description: Louisiana requires 15/30/25 liability insurance, and under R.S. 32:866 uninsured owners cannot recover the first $100,000 of bodily injury or property damage. It has a lemon law for new vehicles, an emissions program in five Baton Rouge-area parishes, and a yearly road usage fee for electric and hybrid vehicles. Act 701 of 2026 ends inspection stickers for personal vehicles outside those parishes on January 1, 2027.

maine.name: Maine
maine.insuranceMinimumDetail: $50,000 bodily injury per person / $100,000 bodily injury per accident / $25,000 property damage, plus $2,000 medical payments and $500 towing and storage (29-A M.R.S. § 1605); uninsured vehicle coverage is also required (24-A M.R.S. § 2902)
maine.lemonLawSummary: Maine's repair duty in Me. Rev. Stat. tit. 10, § 1163 runs during the express warranties, three years, or 18,000 miles, whichever comes first. Three repairs of the same problem, one repair of a serious brake or steering failure, or 15 business days out of service, is the presumption. Write the manufacturer that you want a refund or a replacement. It then has a final repair chance during the seven business days after it receives the letter, and that letter can go out after a single brake or steering failure.
maine.evIncentiveDetails: Efficiency Maine offers income-qualified rebates on all-electric vehicles paired with an off-peak charger: $7,000 new / $3,000 used for low-income buyers and $5,000 new / $2,000 used for moderate-income buyers. A $1,000 enhancement ran through September 30, 2026. Plug-in hybrids and leases are not eligible.
maine.emissionsDetails: Vehicles registered in Cumberland County need an annual enhanced inspection under 29-A M.R.S. § 1751: fuel cap test on 1974 and newer gasoline vehicles and an on-board diagnostics check on 1996 and newer. Maine has adopted California vehicle emissions standards (DEP Chapter 127).
maine.safetyInspectionDetails: Maine requires an annual inspection under 29-A M.R.S. § 1751. The station may charge no more than $12.50 for a standard inspection. A Cumberland County enhanced inspection may not exceed $15.50 for a pre-1996 vehicle or $18.50 for a 1996 or newer vehicle. The fee is due whether the vehicle passes or not.
maine.registrationFeeRange: $35 per year for a passenger vehicle
maine.registrationNotes: Annual excise tax is paid to the town before registration, based on MSRP and age (24 mills in year 1 down to 4 mills from year 6). Passenger registration is $35 a year. Title application $33 for vehicles 25 model years old or newer; 5.5% sales tax on private or out-of-state purchases. New residents have 30 days to register. Vanity plates are an extra $25.
maine.description: Maine requires 50/100/25 liability insurance plus $2,000 medical payments and $500 towing coverage, and an annual safety inspection, with an enhanced emissions inspection in Cumberland County. The Maine Lemon Law includes free state-certified arbitration run by the Attorney General, and Efficiency Maine offers income-qualified rebates on electric vehicles.

maryland.name: Maryland
maryland.insuranceMinimumDetail: $30,000 bodily injury per person / $60,000 bodily injury per accident / $15,000 property damage
maryland.lemonLawSummary: Maryland's lemon law is Md. Code, Com. Law §§ 14-1501 and 14-1502. For this statute the manufacturer's warranty period is the earlier of 18,000 miles or 24 months after delivery. The presumption is four repairs of the same problem, 30 or more days out of service, or one repair of a brake or steering failure that still will not pass the state safety inspection after the manufacturer had a chance to cure. Report the problem by certified mail, return receipt requested, and the manufacturer is supposed to finish the corrections within 30 days of getting that letter.
maryland.evIncentiveDetails: Maryland's EV excise tax credit currently has no funding; applicants are placed on a waiting list.
maryland.emissionsDetails: Eligible vehicles in the VEIP counties are tested every two years. A qualifying new vehicle is first tested 72 months from the model year. The test fee is $30, or $26 at a self-serve kiosk. A vehicle operated only on electricity does not take the emissions test.
maryland.safetyInspectionDetails: Maryland requires a safety inspection when a vehicle is sold or the ownership changes.
maryland.registrationNotes: Those registration amounts include the $40 EMS surcharge. A registration may be renewed for two or three years. Excise tax is 6.5 percent of fair market value.
maryland.evRegistrationDetails: A battery-electric vehicle pays a $125 annual surcharge. A plug-in hybrid pays $100 a year.
maryland.description: Maryland requires liability insurance, safety inspections for vehicle transfers, and has a strong lemon law. The state mandates emissions testing and offers growing EV incentive programs.

massachusetts.name: Massachusetts
massachusetts.insuranceMinimumDetail: $20,000 bodily injury per person / $40,000 bodily injury per accident / $5,000 property damage
massachusetts.lemonLawSummary: Massachusetts calls the coverage a term of protection of one year or 15,000 miles in Mass. Gen. Laws ch. 90, § 7N 1/2, and a business day is a day the authorized dealers' service departments are normally open. Three repairs of the same problem that continues or comes back, or 15 business days out of service, is a reasonable number of attempts. The manufacturer gets one more chance to cure, and that extra chance cannot run longer than seven business days. The buyer does not have to notify the manufacturer directly before using the state's certified new-car arbitration.
massachusetts.evIncentiveDetails: Massachusetts MOR-EV pays $3,500 for new battery EVs with an MSRP up to $55,000 and for income-eligible used EVs, plus $1,500 MOR-EV+ for income-qualified residents and a $1,000 trade-in bonus (mor-ev.org).
massachusetts.emissionsDetails: A light-duty nondiesel vehicle is exempt when its model year is earlier than 1996 or the vehicle is 15 or more model years old. A vehicle operated only on electricity does not take the emissions test. The vehicle still needs the annual safety inspection.
